summary: UMH Properties, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $44.6 million remaining under an existing equity distribution agreement with BMO Capital Markets, J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo, B. Riley, and Compass Point. Shares are sold on the NYSE under ticker UMH at prevailing market prices; the last reported price on May 11, 2026 was $15.57. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is involved. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction with no risk-arb angle.
